message.content:
**Kite**

In the hush of dawn’s first breath,  
A ribbon of wind unfurls—  
A whisper of sky, a promise kept,  
A dance that never curls.

It climbs, a silver arrow,  
Past clouds that sigh and sigh,  
A fleeting, feathered echo,  
Beneath the open sky.

Its tail, a comet’s tail,  
Sways in the sun’s bright gleam,  
A ribbon of stories told,  
In every gust it seems.

Children’s laughter, hands that hold,  
The string that ties the dream;  
A moment bright, a heart of gold,  
Where hope and freedom gleam.

When the day turns to twilight’s hush,  
The kite bows low, a gentle sigh;  
Yet in the night, it still will rush,  
A memory that will never die.
